content.short: Polygon is an Ethereum scaling solution offering low transaction fees and fast transaction processing speeds.
content.description: Polygon, originally known as Matic Network, was launched in 2017 by Jaynti Kanani, Sandeep Nailwal, Anurag Arjun, and Mihailo Bjelic. It is an Ethereum scaling solution that provides developers with low transaction fees and fast processing speeds. The network uses a modified proof-of-stake consensus, achieving consensus with every block. Validators stake MATIC, Polygon's native token, to participate, and those acting in good standing are rewarded with MATIC. Notable customers include Starbucks, Reddit, and Coca-Cola, and web3 projects such as OpenSea and Magic Eden have announced support for Polygon.
